name: Middle-earth Shadow of War
format: Native keyboard-binding file/decoder not verified; known .cfg files are graphics-related
limitations: A firsthand investigation found graphics.cfg and render.cfg but did not establish a keyboard-binding file. Its suggestion that saves own bindings remains speculation.
V3 Map: M -> N is additionally unresolved because users report that map cannot be rebound through the normal controls menu.
No external remapper or device-output change is substituted for an unsupported native mapping.
